summary: First Keystone Corp filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) on May 28, 2026, solely to announce a $0.28/share quarterly cash dividend declared by its board, payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 11, 2026. The release includes standard business updates on balance sheet and income metrics for Q1 2026. There are no M&A, restructuring, tender, activist, or other special-situation elements. This is a routine dividend declaration and operational update with no strategic event, deal terms, or structural change.
